prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic three-image editorial fashion triptych inspired by a classical goddess and ancient-ruins aesthetic. Set all panels among Graeco-Roman stone columns and natural still water, using editorial fashion photography and a naturally slicked-back wet-look hairstyle.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with a consistent non-celebrity identity across all three panels. Keep her styling editorial and goddess-inspired, with naturally slicked-back wet-look hair and gold jewelry. Do not reproduce Sadie Sink or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Panel 1: the adult woman sits on stone among sunlit ancient columns reflected in clear water, wearing an emerald-green sleeveless wrap-style dress with a flattering neckline, triple-layered gold chains, a gold coiled-snake armlet on the right arm, and a thin gold bracelet; her chin is lifted and her expression is mysterious and dreamy. Panel 2: she stands partly immersed in still water in a bright mustard-yellow sleeveless waist-cinched maxi dress, with a snake armlet, small gold studs and matching necklaces; wet hair falls naturally across her face as she looks seriously into the camera. Panel 3: she wades through the water in a navy-blue high-waisted sleeveless dress, wearing a gold coin pendant and the same snake armlet; she looks down toward the water while one hand touches its surface, with a thoughtful, slightly tired expression. Keep the subject, ancient columns, water reflections, gold jewelry language, and triptych visual continuity consistent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use natural daylight with a warm sun-kissed effect. Preserve marble-white stone, clear water, and reflections of columns and fabric. The mood should remain dreamy, mysterious, classical, and cinematic, with realistic wet hair, water movement, and dress drape.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial fashion photography, three-panel triptych or carousel sequence, realistic water and stone texture, natural daylight, consistent adult identity and scale across panels, clean high-detail rendering, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic three-panel editorial fashion triptych of one original adult woman in a classical goddess / ancient-ruins aesthetic among Graeco-Roman columns and natural water. Panel 1: emerald-green sleeveless wrap dress with flattering neckline, triple-layered gold chains, gold coiled-snake armlet and thin bracelet; seated on stone with chin lifted, mysterious dreamy expression, sunlit columns reflected in clear water. Panel 2: bright mustard-yellow sleeveless waist-cinched maxi dress, partly immersed in still water, snake armlet, gold studs and necklaces, wet hair naturally across the face, serious direct gaze. Panel 3: navy-blue high-waisted sleeveless dress, gold coin pendant and matching snake armlet, wading through water, looking down while one hand touches the surface, thoughtful slightly tired expression. Naturally slicked-back wet-look hair, warm sun-kissed daylight, marble-white stone, realistic reflections, cinematic editorial fashion photography, consistent original adult identity, no public-figure likeness.
